race.comment: MODERN GIRL (5) finished off strongly first-up without a trial, ending up 0.2L off the winner. She'll be much better for that effort and the inside barrier this time around is a big tick for her chances. Can go to another level now and looks poised to strike. DREAMS OF DIAMONDS (6) gets the blinkers on for the first time today as she drops down to 1000m. The inside barrier this time can see her close to the speed throughout. Can make an impression. SALVE REGINA (4) is knocking on the door of a maiden win, missing as favourite her past couple. May need some luck from the barrier, but her recent form stacks right up and this presents as a winning opportunity. WHERE'S TIMMY (3) impressed at the trials recently with Steve Parnham on board. Can feature on debut. DREAMLORD (1) finds the right race today.
